cascadeJoinDirection.description: When true and this source is itself an entity-type LEFT-joined upstream, the overrideJoinDirection of this source is propagated into the joins of its inner sub-sources during flattening. Use this on outer-composite -> inner-composite LEFT joins to preserve upstream rows that would otherwise be dropped by a RIGHT JOIN emitted for an inner table.

useIdColumns.description: Whether to use the idColumns of this source as idColumns for the enclosing entity type

inheritCustomFields.description: Whether to inherit custom fields from this source. If false, only core fields will be inherited.

additionalJoinCondition.description: Filter condition to be included in the ON clause of the JOIN for entity type as SQL. This will be ANDed with the generated JOIN condition.
